Welcome. Today, we’re about to step into a story that’s as inspiring as it is complex—a journey that asks us to look closely at what conviction and sacrifice really mean, especially when life takes an unexpected turn.
Imagine leaving behind everything you’ve worked for—fame, fortune, a career in the NFL—because something deeper calls you to serve. That’s exactly what Pat Tillman did after September 11th, driven by a sense of duty that reached far beyond personal ambition.
As we follow his path, we’ll find ourselves exploring so much more than just the facts of his life. We’ll get to see the real person behind the headlines, the struggles between public myth and private truth, and the ripple effects his choices had on his loved ones—and on the entire nation.
In Where Men Win Glory: The Odyssey of Pat Tillman, Jon Krakauer takes us behind the scenes, uncovering the layers of Tillman’s athletic achievements, his military service, and the circumstances around his tragic death in Afghanistan. Through personal letters, candid interviews, and official records, we’re invited to discover what shaped Pat’s character, and to think deeply about what it means to act with integrity when the world is at its most uncertain.
So, as we set off together, get ready to question what you think you know about heroism, patriotism, and the true cost of standing up for what you believe in. Let’s explore this extraordinary journey side by side—and see what new understanding we might find along the way.
